name: animation-engine
description: Deterministic layered 2D animation engine (scene JSON -> frames -> FFmpeg -> MP4)

scripts.example:all: npm run example:assets && tsx examples/kitchen/build-scene.ts && npm run example:feedback && npm run example:render
scripts.playground: tsx examples/playground/generate-assets.ts && tsx examples/playground/process-assets.ts && tsx examples/playground/build-scene.ts && tsx src/cli.ts video examples/playground/scene.json examples/playground/out/playground.mp4
